# Reference-produced fixtures

Both files were produced by another implementation and are never edited
here. `tests/corpus/corpus.ts` re-expresses them as recipes, and
`scripts/generate-vectors.ts` refuses to write `tests/vectors/vectors.json`
unless the working tree reproduces every entry.

- `test-vectors.json` — the 35 vectors generated by the C++ reference
  implementation's `generate-test-vectors` tool and shipped with
  `bc-lifehash-rust`. Each entry has `input` (UTF-8 text or hex per
  `input_type`), `version` (`version1`, `version2`, `detailed`, `fiducial`,
  `grayscale_fiducial`), `module_size`, `has_alpha`, `width`, `height` and
  `colors` (the whole pixel buffer, RGB or RGBA, row-major).
- `golden.json` — 1 000 random inputs rendered by `bc-lifehash-rust`. Each
  entry has `input_hex`, `version`, `module_size`, `has_alpha` and
  `output_sha256`, the SHA-256 of the pixel buffer.
